name: AR_CUST_UPD_BATCH_SUMMARY
description: AR_CUST_UPD_BATCH_SUMMARY contains summary information about customer upload batches.

columns.name: BATCH_NAME
columns.description: Customer upload batch name entered by the user while submitting a customer upload batch.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original source system for the batch data.

columns.name: BATCH_STATUS
columns.description: Overall status of the customer upload batch. Valid values are Process pending, All records successfully uploaded, One or more records failed to upload, and  Process error.

columns.name: UPLOAD_FILE_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Identifer of the customer upload spreadsheet file document.

columns.name: SUCCESS_RECORD_COUNT
columns.description: Indicates the number of records successfully uploaded from the spreadsheet data for a batch.

columns.name: ERROR_RECORD_COUNT
columns.description: Indicates the number of unsuccessful records in the batch.

columns.name: SPREADSHEET_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Customer upload data spreadsheet file name.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
